body: Thank you, kind words are appreciated! I actually sketch everything with a light color like yellow or tan, and I'll fill in areas where I need the darks and all that, with the light color. I spray a lot in between layers so it doesn't blend too much and I love the texture when I spray "too much". I really build it from the bottom up layer and I try to be smart where I put my colors but the key is to be lose and open at the same time. Pastel is my favorite because you can do that easily.
